description:
Outcome: A gardener reports a problem with their plot and the coordinator sees open problems and resolves them, from brief.md / First version must 4.
Scope: Persistent text report with plot, author, timestamp and status; coordinator open queue and resolution; gardener confirmation and own-report history/status. Excludes: attachments and chat.
Acceptance: Only assigned households may report on their own plot; reject cross-household reporting; reports survive restart; idempotent resolution updates the open queue and personal status.
Behaviour: Explain no-assigned-plot cases; prevent duplicate submissions; provide accessible phone-friendly validation, empty/loading/error/retry states.
Verification: Create/read/resolve journey, duplicate-request, persistence and authorization tests. Prerequisites: T-006 and T-004. Assumptions: text-only reports; gardeners can see only their own report status.
title: Problem reporting and resolution
